[ fpp of apa + √ci 2 ; S. apa√ci 2 ], to be honoured; deserving respect ; S I 175, 6* (apacito ~ānaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se apacineyyānaṃ) = Th 186 (’paceyyānaṃ, Be so; Ce ’pacanīyānaṃ; Ee, Se apacineyyānaṃ) quoted Ap-a 567, 30* ( Be, Se ’paceyyānaṃ; Ee apaciniyyānaṃ; not in Ce ); Spk I 259, 20 (tesaṃ yeva apaciti kattabbā ti ~ā, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se apacineyyā); — see also apacita, apacināti 2 , apacineyya, apacetabba.
